general.description: Aroma Coffee & Eatery offers artisanal Indonesian specialty coffee, fresh bakery brunch, and a quiet, cozy atmosphere designed for focus, reading, and meaningful conversations.
general.address: Jl. Senopati No. 88, Kebayoran Baru, South Jakarta

ui.heroTitle: A Warm Sanctuary Amidst the Bustling City.
ui.heroSubtitle: More than just a coffee place. Aroma Coffee & Eatery offers a cozy haven steeped in natural teak wood, soulful lo-fi jazz, plush reading sofas, and a shaded garden patio to unwind over artisanal Indonesian single-origin brews.
ui.footerTagline: A peaceful sanctuary designed for souls who need a moment to pause, reflect, and enjoy fine artisanal coffee.
ui.footerHeartText: Brewed with passion for true coffee lovers

zones.name: The Living Room & Co-Work Lounge
zones.subtitle: Main Indoor Area • Full AC • Non-Smoking
zones.tagline: Quiet, Cool & Tailored for Deep Focus
zones.description: Designed like a warm living room featuring vintage leather sofas, solid reclaimed teak tables, and gentle warm lighting that eases eye strain. Nearly every table has accessible power outlets and high-speed 100 Mbps fiber Wi-Fi with no complex login.
features: Power outlets at every work desk
Chilled AC with fresh filtered air circulation
Gentle lo-fi jazz background music at comfortable volume
Curated art books, design journals & coffee magazines
zones.bestFor: Remote working (WFH), reading books, or quiet one-on-one meetings

zones.name: The Slow Bar & Roastery Corner
zones.subtitle: Barista Counter • Interactive Space
zones.tagline: Witness the Craft & Inhale Freshly Roasted Aromas
zones.description: Take a high wooden bar stool and watch our certified baristas hand-pour your coffee drop by drop via V60 or Aeropress. Enjoy casual conversations about the origin of our Kintamani, Gayo, and Toraja beans freshly roasted on-site every week.
features: Direct interaction with certified master baristas
Rotating weekly selection of rare Indonesian single origins
Glass display jars of fresh whole-bean roasts
Aesthetic front-row view of our La Marzocco espresso machine
zones.bestFor: Manual brew connoisseurs, solo visitors, or intimate chats

zones.name: Garden Patio & Outdoor Terrace
zones.subtitle: Semi-Outdoor Garden • Smoking Friendly • Pet-Friendly
zones.tagline: Gentle Breeze Under Shaded Leafy Trees
zones.description: An airy open courtyard surrounded by lush tropical greenery, gravel stone flooring, and sun canopies. At dusk, warm string festoon lights illuminate the terrace, creating a magical setting for cold brew drinks with your beloved four-legged companion.
features: Open-air smoking allowed with natural breeze
Romantic fairy string lights every evening
Spacious circular tables accommodating groups of 4-6
zones.bestFor: Late afternoon catch-ups, open-air hangout with pets, relaxed evenings

zones.name: The Creative Nook & Meeting Corner
zones.subtitle: Semi-Private Space • Team Collaboration
zones.tagline: A Dedicated Corner for Sparks of Ideas
zones.description: Tucked away from the main walkway, featuring an 8-seater solid suar wood communal table, glass idea whiteboard, and dedicated presentation lighting. Ideal for creative agency brainstorms, small workshops, or study groups.
features: Communal table seating up to 8-10 people
Semi-acoustic wall paneling to reduce ambient sound
Glass whiteboard with dry-erase markers & extension cords
Bookable in advance with zero room rental surcharges
zones.bestFor: Team strategy sessions, creative pitches, or small gatherings

menu.name: Aroma Palm Sugar Latte
menu.description: Double espresso shot combined with velvety oat milk and authentic liquid organic palm sugar from West Java.
menu.pairing: Pairs delightfully with a freshly warmed Almond Croissant.

menu.name: Spanish Butterscotch Macchiato
menu.description: Bold espresso layered with savory butterscotch caramel, balanced condensed milk, and sea salt cream foam.
menu.pairing: The perfect afternoon companion while reading a novel.

menu.name: Pandan Cold Brew Foam
menu.description: 16-hour slow steeped cold brew topped with fragrant pandan coconut foam and natural sweetness.
menu.pairing: Incredibly refreshing when enjoyed in our garden patio.

menu.name: V60 Bali Kintamani Natural
menu.description: Artisanal hand-pour V60 filter highlighting vibrant citrus acidity and wild honey floral sweetness.
menu.pairing: Best savored warm with no added sugar to enjoy pure terroir notes.

menu.name: V60 Aceh Gayo Wine Fermentation
menu.description: Specially fermented whole coffee cherries yielding fragrant red wine notes and rich dark grape sweetness.
menu.pairing: An adventurous cup for specialty coffee explorers.

menu.name: Artisan Uji Ceremonial Matcha
menu.description: Rich ceremonial green tea powder whisked with bamboo chasen and blended with steamed oat milk.
menu.pairing: A soothing, mindful caffeine alternative for mental clarity.

menu.name: Almond Frangipane Croissant
menu.description: Double-baked French butter croissant filled with luscious sweet almond frangipane cream and toasted sliced almonds.
menu.pairing: The classic breakfast duo with a hot Americano or Caffe Latte.

menu.name: Truffle Mushroom Beef Croissant
menu.description: Flaky butter pastry stuffed with smoked beef sirloin, sauteed champignon mushrooms, garlic cream, and aromatic truffle oil.
menu.pairing: A satisfying, gourmet brunch plate to fuel your productive workday.

schedule.label: Morning Calm & Coffee Ritual
schedule.description: Crisp morning air, gentle sunlight streaming through floor-to-ceiling glass, fresh roast aromas, and soft acoustic vinyl records.
schedule.ideal: Breakfast coffee + croissant, reading the morning paper, planning your workday.

schedule.label: Deep Work & Co-Working Hours
schedule.description: Pleasantly chilled AC, soothing instrumental lo-fi beats, uninterrupted 100 Mbps Wi-Fi, and convenient power sockets everywhere.
schedule.ideal: Focused laptop sprint, client discussions, collaborative project writing.

schedule.label: Golden Hour & Evening Chill
schedule.description: The outdoor garden patio cools down under amber string lights, evening breezes flow, and warm conversations start over iced brews.
schedule.ideal: Catching up with close friends, casual dates, unwinding after work.

reviews.name: Aulia Rahmadina
reviews.comment: By far the most comfortable cafe to work from in Senopati! The Palm Sugar Latte and Truffle Croissant are heavenly. Fast Wi-Fi, abundant outlets, and the music volume is always spot on.

reviews.name: Dimas Prasetyo
reviews.comment: The V60 Kintamani Natural is extracted to perfection. The baristas are genuinely passionate and welcoming. The slow bar counter makes you want to sit and talk coffee for hours.

reviews.name: Jessica Tanuwijaya
reviews.comment: The semi-outdoor garden patio is wonderfully shaded in the late afternoon. I love bringing my golden retriever along while working on my drafts. Truly pet-friendly and welcoming staff.
